basic_info.description: Welcome to a spacious and updated 1 bed / 1 bath condo on the third floor of a modern elevator building in the heart of the Marina.     New hardwood floors and abundant natural light create a warm, contemporary feel throughout. The remodeled kitchen features stainless steel appliances and a convenient breakfast bar, while the sleek bathroom offers gleaming marble finishes and smart ambient lighting for that perfect wind-down glow. The oversized bedroom includes a large walk-in closet - rare and so appreciated.     Need extra flex space? The enclosed solarium is ready for your WFH setup, Peloton rides, or plant collection, adding approximately 80 s.f. to the already spacious layout.     Additional highlights include in-unit laundry, generous storage, deeded one-car parking, and HOA dues that cover earthquake insurance, water, garbage, and weekly common area cleaning. With a 98 Walk Score and the best of Chestnut, Union, and Fillmore Streets just moments away, you're set for effortless Marina living.
